name: Web Development
description: HTML, CSS and JavaScript through React, backend APIs and deploying a full-stack app.

nodes.name: How the web works
nodes.desc: Browsers, servers, URLs, DNS and what happens when you load a page.
nodes.summary: You will be able to explain what happens between typing a URL and seeing a page, including DNS, servers and browsers.

nodes.name: HTTP basics
nodes.desc: Requests and responses, methods, status codes, headers, cookies and caching.
nodes.summary: You will be able to read and reason about HTTP requests and responses, including methods, status codes, headers, cookies and caching.

nodes.name: HTML & CSS
nodes.desc: Semantic HTML, the CSS box model, selectors and the cascade.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write semantic HTML and style it with CSS selectors, the box model and the cascade.

nodes.name: Layout & responsive
nodes.desc: Flexbox, CSS grid, media queries and mobile-first design.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build responsive layouts with Flexbox, CSS grid and media queries using a mobile-first approach.

nodes.name: Accessibility
nodes.desc: Semantic structure, keyboard navigation, ARIA basics and colour contrast.
nodes.summary: You will be able to make pages accessible with semantic structure, keyboard support, basic ARIA and sufficient colour contrast.

nodes.name: JavaScript
nodes.desc: Values, functions, closures, objects, arrays and modules.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write JavaScript using values, functions, closures, objects, arrays and modules for the browser.

nodes.name: DOM & events
nodes.desc: Selecting and updating elements, event listeners and form handling.
nodes.summary: You will be able to select and update page elements and respond to user input with event listeners and form handling.

nodes.name: Async JavaScript
nodes.desc: The event loop, promises, async/await and fetching data.
nodes.summary: You will be able to fetch data asynchronously with promises and async/await and understand how the event loop schedules work.

nodes.name: Interactive page
nodes.desc: Build a responsive single-page tool in plain JavaScript that fetches data from a public API.
nodes.summary: You will build a responsive single-page tool in plain JavaScript that fetches and displays data from a public API.

nodes.name: TypeScript
nodes.desc: Static types for JavaScript: annotations, interfaces, generics and narrowing.
nodes.summary: You will be able to add static types to JavaScript with annotations, interfaces, generics and narrowing.

nodes.name: React
nodes.desc: Components, JSX, props and rendering lists.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build user interfaces from React components using JSX and props and render lists of data.

nodes.name: State & hooks
nodes.desc: useState, useEffect, lifting state up, and data fetching in components.
nodes.summary: You will be able to manage component state with useState, run effects with useEffect and fetch data inside components.

nodes.name: Routing & forms
nodes.desc: Client-side routing, controlled forms and validation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to add client-side routing to a React app and build controlled forms with validation.

nodes.name: React app
nodes.desc: Build a multi-page React app with routing, forms and data from an external API.
nodes.summary: You will build a multi-page React app with routing, forms and data loaded from an external API.
topics: Project setup with a build tool

nodes.name: Node.js servers
nodes.desc: Running JavaScript on the server, npm, and handling requests with a framework like Express.
nodes.summary: You will be able to run JavaScript on the server with Node.js and handle HTTP requests with a framework like Express.

nodes.name: REST APIs
nodes.desc: Resource design, routes, status codes, JSON, validation and pagination.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design REST APIs with clear resources, routes, status codes, validation and pagination.

nodes.name: Databases for web
nodes.desc: Connecting a backend to SQL, migrations, ORMs and avoiding N+1 queries.
nodes.summary: You will be able to connect a backend to a SQL database with migrations and an ORM and avoid N+1 query problems.

nodes.name: Authentication
nodes.desc: Password hashing, sessions versus tokens, cookies and OAuth sign-in.
nodes.summary: You will be able to implement secure sign-in with hashed passwords, sessions or tokens, secure cookies and OAuth.
topics: Password hashing with bcrypt or argon2

nodes.name: REST backend
nodes.desc: Build a REST API with a database, authentication and tests for a small domain like a notes or bookmarks app.
nodes.summary: You will build a REST API with a database, authentication and automated tests for a small domain such as notes or bookmarks.

nodes.name: Web security
nodes.desc: XSS, CSRF, SQL injection, CORS and HTTPS.
nodes.summary: You will be able to recognise and defend against XSS, CSRF and SQL injection and configure CORS and HTTPS correctly.

nodes.name: Performance
nodes.desc: Measuring load and render time, bundling, code splitting, image optimisation and HTTP caching.
nodes.summary: You will be able to measure and improve page load and render performance with bundling, code splitting, image optimisation and caching.

nodes.name: Testing
nodes.desc: Unit, component and end-to-end tests for frontend and backend.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write unit, component and end-to-end tests for both frontend and backend code.

nodes.name: Deployment
nodes.desc: Environments and config, building for production, hosting, CI/CD and monitoring.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build and deploy web apps to production with environment config, CI/CD pipelines and monitoring.

nodes.name: Full-stack app
nodes.desc: Ship a full-stack app: React frontend, REST backend with auth and a database, tests, and a live deployment.
nodes.summary: You will ship a full-stack app with a React frontend, an authenticated REST backend with a database, tests and a live deployment.
